title: Gold Dust Woman
disambiguation: hard start, glass break, soft howling
annotation:
There are 4 variations of this track on various releases of Rumours. Some fade in, some have a hard start. Some have a glass breaking noise at around the 4:00 mark, and some have more pronounced howling noises at the end. There are 4 separate recordings

~4:52 - fade in, glass break, soft howling
~5:00 - fade in, no glass break, loud howling
~5:02 - hard start, glass break, soft howling
~5:08 - hard start, no glass break, loud howling
